result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or visible pedestrian signals. The expansive asphalt area and lack of lane channelization likely encourage higher vehicle speeds and result in long, unprotected crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible across the wide intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While traffic lights are present for vehicles, no dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate safe crossing times.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road at a signalized intersection that lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The environment is heavily oriented toward vehicle throughput, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic over a significant crossing distance without a refuge.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time safely.

result.summary: This residential intersection provides basic sidewalk connectivity but lacks essential pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic control devices. The presence of 'Do Not Enter' signs indicates a one-way street configuration, yet the environment remains hostile due to poor sightlines and a lack of designated crossing areas.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to alert drivers to pedestrian presence or define a safe path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection mouth

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and dense vegetation on the corners block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to control vehicle flow through the intersection, increasing the risk of collisions.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and sidewalk creates tripping hazards and poor traction.

interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or other traffic calming measures to regulate vehicle speeds and right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Upgrade existing curb transitions with detectable warning surfaces and proper slopes for accessibility.
